sentence: This project combines mathematical modeling and laboratory experiments to predict where and how certain structures form in the genome and what physical rules shape them.
This project gets a confocal microscope to image live and fixed tissues in research on cancer, diabetes and stem cells.
This project uses wearable technology to capture how people move after a ruptured anterior cruciate ligament, aiming to improve rehabilitation.
This project studies how the parasite Toxoplasma gondii crosses the placental barrier and passes from a mother to her fetus.
This project tests a chest patch and phone app that record heart signals of caregivers and young autistic children during everyday activities at home.
This project studies whether genomic changes or changes in the microenvironment drive precursor lesions of pancreatic cancer to progress in human samples.
This project builds an automated tool that uses artificial intelligence and computer vision to assess surgical skill in robotic hiatal hernia repair.
This project combines genetic data, blood proteins and artificial intelligence models to predict who is at risk of flare-ups of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease.
This project studies how proteins that macrophages acquire from other cells during cell-cell contact change the macrophages into a different state.
This project develops biomarkers that use sequencing of microbial DNA in blood plasma to diagnose sepsis in trauma patients.
This project tests whether changes in small particles called extracellular vesicles released by brain cells help cause mesial temporal lobe epilepsy and Dravet syndrome.
This project builds artificial intelligence models to predict which T-cell receptors match which mutation-derived peptides and how peptides are displayed to T cells.
This project studies what adult hospital patients say about their suicide attempts and the hours before them to find warning signs that were overlooked.
This project offers mass cytometry, flow cytometry and sequencing data analysis to study immune responses in tumor models and human research.
This project studies how the body's antibody response reacts to HIV vaccine immunogens, to help design a vaccine that gives broad protection against HIV.
This project studies how phosphorylation of a protein called Rad controls calcium channel function in the heart's fight-or-flight response.
This project uses computational methods and sensing technologies to automatically measure patient status in real time and monitor delirium in critical care.
This project makes small molecules that block a protease, to explore its biology and test them as compounds against aging.
This project studies how neurons move mitochondria and keep them in good condition, which is impaired in several neurodegenerative diseases.
